summary: Core frontend pages, routing, luxury-themed styling, affiliate disclosure content, and an admin CRUD UI with Internet Identity-based gating are implemented. Backend includes an in-canister product store with admin-only create/update/delete and public read methods, but required category-specific listing and stable persistence across upgrades are not evidenced. Some additional user-profile onboarding functionality appears added but was not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend must expose query methods to list products by category and fetch a product by id.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend shows `getProduct(id)` and `listProducts()` but does not show a query method to list by category (e.g., `listProductsByCategory(category)`). Frontend instead filters client-side after calling `listProducts()`.

missing_requirements.requirement: Data persists across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns appropriate for the template.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend uses in-memory `Map.empty` stores for products and user profiles, but no stable variables and no `preupgrade`/`postupgrade` (or equivalent stable-storage pattern) are shown, so persistence across upgrades is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each product has a details view with a prominent outbound affiliate link button that opens in a new browser tab.
missing_requirements.reason: A `ProductDetailsPage` route is wired, but the implementation of `frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailsPage` is not included in the diff summary, so the presence of the outbound link and `target="_blank"` behavior is not evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: An app icon/favicon is set using generated assets.
missing_requirements.reason: Generated images are referenced in header/footer/hero, but no favicon/app-icon configuration (e.g., in an `index.html`, manifest, or head config) is shown in the diff summary, so setting the favicon is not evidenced.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile management (get/save user profile) and a forced profile setup modal on first login.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on affiliate browsing and admin product management; user profile CRUD and onboarding modal were not requested requirements or acceptance criteria.

hallucinated_features.description: Access-control initialization via a secret URL parameter `caffeineAdminToken` and calling `_initializeAccessControlWithSecret`.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest requires Internet Identity gating for admin access but does not request secret-token based initialization or URL-secret parameters.
